propositions: voter_errors and replication_errors alarms declare neither alarm_actions nor ok_actions, so CloudWatch transitions fire silently with no operator notification
eleven of thirteen aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm blocks in infra/terraform/ wire both alarm_actions and ok_actions to aws_sns_topic.alerts; these two omissions violate the established convention
the alarm's own header claims voter_errors surfaces a broken voter to an operator, but the resource does not deliver notifications

test_alarm_actions_terraform.py guard parses all alarm blocks under infra/terraform/ and fails on any lacking alarm_actions, with mandatory anti-vacuity assertion and explicit documented opt-out marker
terraform apply is required to activate the changes; merging HCL alone does not wire the alarms to SNS in production
scope includes both voter_errors (monitoring_s4b.tf) and replication_errors (monitoring_s5.tf) to avoid rediscovery of the same defect in a sibling resource
